title: Expansion admission protocol
description: Objective: implement bounded expansion request, quality assessment, all-or-none refusal, exact budget preparation, and graph-level approval. Deliverable: core/scheduler expansion modules and race tests. NOT in scope: automatic approval or partial child activation. Hard dependencies: Anti-blocking admission, Fair scheduler production, Policy approval core, and Conserved budget core. Owned paths: packages/core/src/expansion/** and packages/scheduler/src/expansion/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Expansion is refused unless all quality, scope, budget, capacity, and dependency preconditions pass.
Approval binds exact proposed revision and prepared resources; a changed delta requires reapproval.
No child obtains authority from a partially admitted expansion.
Focused core and scheduler tests pass.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.

comments.content: SPIDR decomposition after committed-byte audit (authoritative design hash verified). This parent is a decomposition shell: its honest implementation requires >10 paths and crosses independent hold, PlanningRun schema/behavior, scheduler admission, approval/preparation, publication, and hardening authorities. Created and—per human instruction—moved all six children to PLANNING: (1) task-7f089e11daea44e9a483197ff139d725 Expansion planning hold lifecycle; (2) task-fcad40b6d26243439cd19fd3e49c924d Planning expansion contract binding; (3) task-93b0314e09f248118e21f92699989468 Planning-run expansion submission; (4) task-2561a780fdd149439c9858c9c7b459e8 Scheduler expansion admission; (5) task-b863bae80fab426db7b6204f9d713c42 Expansion manual approval binding; (6) task-a1e7f75e9681486cb0a8f93e9397b8b5 Expansion protocol public hardening. They are dependency-ordered and file-disjoint. Hard external blockers remain: Fair scheduler production task-10cab3e5cdad4296bd7632bcda7b20f3 is BLOCKED and packages/scheduler/src/fairness is absent; Graph supersession engine task-dddfaf83f9c644099b5b263e485c58c7 is BACKLOG. Do not plan child 4 against caller capacity/testkit fairness or child 5 against invented preparation/fence records. Durable atomic child activation remains task-9634ed3b72014fe781591c7df9674da2; the pure protocol proves only all-or-none decisions and zero authority before that consumer transaction.
